📊 Pixels AMA Recap: Sustainability and Scaling Strategy @pixels_online 

The latest Pixels weekly AMA focused on the team's transition from developing "Endgame" content to building a sustainable growth model. 

Here is the breakdown of the key technical and strategic updates:

1. Economic Sustainability (RORS)
The team’s primary metric is now Return on Reward Spend (RORS). The goal is to ensure that for every token rewarded, the ecosystem recaptures more value through in-game spending. 

Currently, the Core game and Stacked are successfully operating as net-burn systems, which helps prevent the high inflation seen in previous versions of the game.

2. Automated Reward Targeting (The Stacked Agent)

To move away from manual reward management, the team has deployed the "Stacked Agent" in production. 

This AI-driven system uses data science models to automate how tasks and rewards are distributed. It aims to provide players with more relevant tasks based on their playstyle while making it harder for botting to remain profitable.

3. User Acquisition (UA) & Chubkins
Chubkins is being used as a testing ground for paid advertising.

>Metrics: Early tests in the US show a customer acquisition cost of $1.50–$2.50, which the team considers a strong indicator for scaling.

>Rollout: Chubkins will expand to the Philippines and Brazil in approximately 30 days once the next layer of gameplay polish is finished.

4. The Move to Mobile-Native

The team is shifting focus toward mobile-native builds for Core Pixels. This move is intended to improve player retention (through native notifications) and allow for USD monetization via credit cards. 

This revenue will be used to fund further user acquisition, creating a self-sustaining growth loop.

5. Staking Reward Updates

To protect the $PIXEL token from unnecessary emissions, staking rewards will eventually transition to USDC. 

This allows the foundation to reward stakers with stable value while reducing the amount of new $PIXEL entering the market.

6. Upcoming Changes

>Tier 5 for Managers: Starting next week, land managers will be able to expand and extend T5 slots.

>Taskboard Migration: The Taskboard will continue its transition into the Stacked app over the next month to better utilize the new reward targeting tech.

>Events: Heidi will be at Balkans Blockchain Week in Kosovo next month representing the ecosystem.
